DecimalNumber, Integer and Variable

Source: R/numbers.R
DecimalNumberClass.Rd

A number typeset digit by digit (with LaTeX by default) that can be updated with set_value(), for example in an updater or with ChangeDecimalToValue(). Variable() shows label = value driven by a ValueTracker() stored in $tracker.

Usage

DecimalNumber(
  number = 0,
  num_decimal_places = 2,
  mob_class = MathTex,
  include_sign = FALSE,
  group_with_commas = TRUE,
  digit_buff_per_font_unit = 0.001,
  show_ellipsis = FALSE,
  unit = NULL,
  unit_buff_per_font_unit = 0,
  include_background_rectangle = FALSE,
  edge_to_fix = LEFT,
  font_size = DEFAULT_FONT_SIZE,
  stroke_width = 0,
  fill_opacity = 1,
  ...
)

Integer(number = 0, num_decimal_places = 0, ...)

Variable(var, label, var_type = "decimal", num_decimal_places = 2, ...)

Arguments

number

The number (real or complex).

num_decimal_places

Digits after the decimal point.

mob_class

Constructor for each character, MathTex() by default.

include_sign

Always show the sign.

group_with_commas

Insert thousands separators.

digit_buff_per_font_unit

Gap between characters per font size unit.

show_ellipsis

Append an ellipsis.

unit

Optional unit string; aligned to the top when it starts with ^.

unit_buff_per_font_unit

Gap before the unit.

include_background_rectangle

Add a background rectangle.

edge_to_fix

Edge kept fixed when the value changes.

font_size

Font size.

stroke_width, fill_opacity

Style.

...

Passed to VMobject().

var

Initial value of the variable.

label

Label string (typeset with MathTex()) or a mobject.

var_type

"decimal" or "integer" (or the constructors DecimalNumber / Integer).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
d <- DecimalNumber(3.14159, num_decimal_places = 3)
d$set_value(2.71828)
} # }
